daily.title: Japan megabanks to skip third batch of U.S. investments
daily.summary: The three — MUFG Bank, Mizuho Bank and Sumitomo Mitsui Banking — are making final arrangements to forgo participation.

daily.title: Women’s expectations for Takaichi turn to disappointment
daily.summary: "Many expected progress on policies related to women, but little visible progress has been made," said an Ochanomizu University professor.

daily.title: Japan considers broader definition of security spending to inflate defense outlays, sources say
daily.summary: The government is looking at whether spending on areas like AI, satellites and infrastructure could be classified as defense-related costs.

daily.title: TSMC seeks factory-equipment alternatives to thwart China’s rare earths grip, sources say
daily.summary: Rare-earth magnets are used in motors that power moving parts in industrial equipment, including machinery found in highly automated factories.

daily.title: Lula hopes older voters can help power him to victory against Flavio Bolsonaro
daily.summary: Lula's campaign is now actively targeting the so-called "Lula generation" — seniors age over 70, close in age to the 80-year-old president.

daily.title: ‘In my DNA’: Why Osaka’s high-risk danjiri festivals refuse to slow down
daily.summary: A pair of fatal incidents this month has revived a long-running debate: Does Osaka's high-risk danjiri festival still have a place in modern society?

daily.title: Japan’s biggest labor union federation calls for 6% wage hike in 2027
daily.summary: Member unions typically submit their wage demands by around February, with companies responding from March onward.

daily.title: NPA suspects police in Kanagawa used old drivers’ licenses illegally
daily.summary: The national police agency has instructed Kanagawa police to confirm the facts in full detail, and has set up a team to conduct a probe nationwide.

daily.title: SoftBank market value halves from peak as AI fears grow
daily.summary: After briefly overtaking Toyota as Japan's biggest company, SoftBank's market capitalization is now smaller than that of Hitachi and Recruit.

daily.title: Liberte, egalite, misere? Why France is burning
daily.summary: It's not only France that's feeling the heat. Anger about inflation, from energy prices to housing costs, has led to clashes in Italy and Portugal.

daily.title: Taiwan’s resilience must be built before a crisis
daily.summary: Taiwan has focused heavily on military readiness against China, but it now faces a tougher question: how its society will deal with prolonged duress.

daily.summary: The threats deal a blow to South Korean President Lee Jae Myung's efforts to ease inter-Korean hostility.

daily.summary: A strike on a Saudi Aramco facility killed two people while an attack on the King Fahd International Airport in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, killed one.

daily.title: Bank, business and ministry websites halted after PHP vulnerabilities announced
daily.summary: International authorities have urged site administrators to immediately update software to prevent unauthorized access and potential data exposure.

daily.title: An estranged mother and daughter face the music in ‘Echoes of Motherhood’
daily.summary: Despite some perplexing plot holes, Ryutaro Nakagawa's "Echoes of Motherhood" is marked by a powerhouse performance by Naomi Kawase.

daily.title: Taiwan probes organized crime links to China’s ‘transnational repression’
daily.summary: Taipei has complained that Beijing is using various underhanded methods to target Taiwanese nationals viewed as politically suspect.

daily.title: Japan to introduce cashless traffic fine payments from July
daily.summary: Fines are currently payable only at bank or post office counters, which are unavailable outside business hours.

daily.summary: The prime minister will be under pressure as the bill starts to come due for big promises made.

daily.title: Japan life insurers’ bond-buying plans set to support JGBs

daily.title: Family of driver who died after truck fell into Saitama sinkhole sues prefecture

daily.title: Two Japanese climbers missing in the Himalayas
daily.summary: The two Japanese nationals have been out of contact since Oct. 15 and local authorities have been searching for them.

daily.title: Japan and U.S. to conduct drills under extreme conditions as typhoon nears

daily.title: Supplies of rare earth yttrium have ‘stalled,’ industry ministry official says

daily.title: Tesla’s spending on AI and robotics trails expectations, clouding outlook
daily.summary: Heavy spending is needed to help Tesla reorient operations around futuristic business lines, a shift seen as justifying a merger with SpaceX.

daily.title: Strict rules at shelters deter victims of domestic violence in Japan
